item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 29/Aug/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The tropical cyclone over the central and northern parts of the South China Sea will continue to develop and move towards the seas south of Hainan Island today. Meanwhile, under the combined effect of the tropical cyclone and a ridge of high pressure over southeastern China, it will be windy with a few showers and squally thunderstorms over the northern part of the South China Sea and the coast of southern China. There will be swells. With the departure of the tropical cyclone, the weather will improve slightly over the coast of Guangdong during the weekend. Upper-air disturbances are expected to bring showers to the coast of Guangdong early next week. Under the influence of an anticyclone aloft, the weather will be mainly fine over southern China in the middle and latter parts of next week.
